302f6d.title: Root reachability and public landing evidence
302f6d.content: `http://172.23.0.2:5000/` returned HTTP 200 through the injected AIDAST proxy, server `Werkzeug/2.0.1 Python/3.9.25`, title `VulnBank - The Modern Banking Platform`. The landing HTML references `/login`, `/merchant/login`, `/register`, `/api/docs/`, `/api/ai/chat/anonymous`, `/blog`, `/careers`, `/compliance`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, plus static assets. `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` each returned HTTP 404. `https://172.23.0.2:5000/` produced mitmproxy 502 body: `The remote server does not speak TLS.` Self-service registration is publicly linked, and anonymous AI chat is a public JSON API candidate for route/parameter discovery only.

b1db27.title: Web surface map — 172.23.0.2:5000
b1db27.content:
Discovery-only evidence is saved under `/workspace/recon/` (`katana.jsonl`, `static_openapi.json.body`, public-page bodies/headers). Captured proxy evidence: root `457243a6-5251-4e71-8e61-89f40a2464cd` (HTTP 200, Werkzeug/2.0.1 Python/3.9.25), OpenAPI `eac25510-20e5-4790-95ed-abd19bf8f8ae` (HTTP 200 JSON, 50,674 bytes), merchant dashboard `8398f395-13ee-4950-8058-e62c8f9c215c` (HTTP 200 HTML, includes charge-form field names).

HTTP `http://172.23.0.2:5000/` is live; HTTPS on `:5000` receives mitmproxy 502 with exact text `The remote server does not speak TLS.` Robots and sitemap both 404. Bounded Katana (`-d 3 -ct 90s -jc -xhr -kf all`, explicit proxy) found 32 unique URLs and public pages: `/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/forgot-password`, `/merchant/login`, `/merchant/register`, `/merchant/dashboard`, `/dashboard` (link), `/api/docs` and `/api/docs/`, `/blog`, `/careers`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/compliance`, plus static assets. Browser rendered the public forms; no submissions/registration. `merchant/dashboard` delivers 200 HTML, then its client logic navigates unauthenticated browser sessions to `/merchant/login`.

OpenAPI 3.0 at `/static/openapi.json` supplies 37 documented operation paths across auth, transactions, users, admin, virtual cards, bill payments, merchants/payments, AI and internal/meta-data routes; see saved JSON for exact schemas. Bearer JWT and `X-Merchant-Api-Key` are declared security schemes. Client JS adds `POST /api/ai/chat/anonymous` with JSON `{message}`, and merchant JS uses `/api/v1/merchants/{register,login,me}` plus `/api/v1/payments{,/charge}`. Merchant charge UI fields: amount, currency, card_number, cvv, expiry_date, merchant_order_id, description.

Gaps: no authenticated exploration or account creation (per child constraint); no state-changing API/form submissions; no ports other than explicitly scoped 5000 were identified/enumerated; no robots/sitemap content. Swagger spec advertises `https://vulnbank.org`, and pages reference external font/GitHub/social URLs; all are out of approved scope and were not manually accessed.

be62cf.title: Authenticated consumer dashboard discovery
be62cf.content:
Root created exactly one disposable low-privilege consumer account through the public `/register` UI (POST 200), then logged in via `/login` (POST 200) and reached `/dashboard` (GET 200). No business transaction or state-changing banking action was submitted after account/login creation. Dashboard UI routes are in-page anchors: `#profile`, `#transfers`, `#loans`, `#transactions`, `#virtual-cards`, `#bill-payments`. Observed authenticated read-only fetches: `GET /transactions/{own_account_number}`, `GET /api/virtual-cards`, `GET /api/bill-categories`, `GET /api/bill-payments/history`. Dashboard UI fields: profile upload `profile_picture`; profile bio `bio`; transfer `to_account`, `amount`, `description`; loan `amount`; virtual card creation `card_limit`, `currency`, `card_type`; virtual-card funding `card_id`, `amount`; bill payment category selection, `biller_id`, `amount`, `payment_method`, `card_id`, `description`.

Static dashboard JS additionally discloses endpoints: `POST /transfer`, `POST /request_loan`, `POST /upload_profile_picture`, `POST /upload_profile_picture_url` (field `image_url`), `POST /update_bio`, `GET /api/virtual-cards`, `POST /api/virtual-cards/create`, `GET /api/bill-categories`, `POST /api/bill-payments/create`, `GET /api/bill-payments/history`, and `/api/ai/rate-limit-status`.
